learner_operation: Use y=vx to obtain xv'=F(v)-v, separate/integrate and back-substitute; distinguish the surviving signed coefficient in five mathematical solution candidates. A valid shortcut through differentiation or linearity of the parameter still expresses this operation.

fixed_features.feature: Homogeneous first-order ODE; provided substitution y=v(x)x; five mathematical radio choices
fixed_features.justification: All three easy source questions explicitly provide that substitution and radio response. Tutorial fe0a9e9e-ab23-5364-99bb-cddbfd67a4a4 derives xv'=F(v)-v.

fixed_features.feature: Cubic inverse-square cancellation, affine coefficient two, and affine coefficient one templates
fixed_features.justification: Represent the three labelled easy integrations. Fixing one template per instance preserves workload; all three appear in sampling. The varied x-term coefficient is eligible answer-bearing evidence.

fixed_features.feature: Nonzero small integer a from -9 through 9
fixed_features.justification: Nonzero prevents collapse to y'=y/x and removal of integration work. Nine is a conservative arithmetic bound, not an intrinsic learning constraint. Signed coefficients preserve the source method.

fixed_features.feature: Same mathematical solution form for all five extension choices
fixed_features.justification: Correct form is information available in the source differential equation; requiring the multiplier/sign to be determined removes the old unique-shape and fixed-magnitude cues without introducing a new method.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Small nonzero signs and magnitudes, derived into logarithm multiplier or affine particular solution
answer_roles.observed: Fresh samples exercise all 18 bank indices per family; controlled negative, sign-crossing and wraparound banks exercise all five target coefficients.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Each of five candidates can solve an eligible ODE with the bank held fixed; order and actual UI layout are incidental
answer_roles.observed: Nine same-bank groups cover all five correct mathematical roles. Actual UI shuffles UUIDs; raw-position, concrete UI-position, string-length and coefficient-rank probes saved.

coverage.case: Changed bank construction and fresh random sampler
coverage.result: 54 fresh bank-window constructions, 24 fresh random instances, and 45 controlled role assignments; all three families and signed boundary cases.
5/5 survive; affine 1, cube-root 2, linear-log 2. No old prompt-blind shape predictor applies. Across the full batch no tested fixed rank, length or position strategy solves all five.

coverage.case: Retained counterexample and supplied strict executable checks
coverage.result: Old cube-root a=2 seed=826033 exhibits original unique-root defect. Identical parameters now give five root candidates. Supplied assertions fail on old construction and pass current construction.
